summary: Probed llm_client dependency. LLMConfig (types.py) has no json_mode field — adding bool field (default False) is safe. Provider call() methods (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter) have no json_mode param — need adding. complete()/complete_with_retry() do not forward json_mode to providers — need threading. OpenRouterProvider overrides call() entirely (no super delegation) so needs its own json_mode branch. structured_llm uses config: dict[str,Any] duck-typing — propagation will use dataclasses.replace for LLMConfig instances or dict copy for plain dicts (stdlib dataclasses, no cross-module import). No contract mismatches that change phase scope.

Phase 5 (structured_llm, Build, non-leaf: depends on llm_client): 5 steps. Dep probe: LLMConfig lacks json_mode field (adding bool default-False is safe); all four provider call() methods need json_mode param; complete() needs to forward it. OpenRouterProvider overrides call() fully so needs its own branch. Anthropic has no response_format API -- will use assistant prefill; asymmetry documented in D-11. Propagation strategy (dataclasses.replace vs dict copy) recorded in D-10. Steps: 5.1 thread json_mode into LLMConfig+providers; 5.2 OpenAI/OpenRouter response_format; 5.3 Gemini mime_type; 5.4 Anthropic prefill+docs; 5.5 structured_call param+ARCH update.
Added json_mode to LLMConfig and threaded it through complete() to provider calls with regression coverage for default and enabled paths.
OpenAI and OpenRouter now emit response_format json_object and a json prompt hint when json_mode is enabled, with off-path behavior unchanged.
Step 5.3 (Gemini response_mime_type) implemented, tested, committed 5b1fb2b; completion recorded post-hoc after fixing i2c-on-PATH for the worker.
AnthropicProvider now uses a json_mode assistant prefill plus JSON prompt hint, with raw-content reconstruction guarded by a provider test harness.
Structured_call now accepts opt-in json_mode, copies config only when enabled, and regression tests cover off-by-default and enabled propagation.

Phase 5 review: 2 Must fixes applied. (1) pyproject.toml missing pytest importlib mode — test_core.py module name collision when running llm_client and structured_llm tests together; fixed by adding --import-mode=importlib. (2) structured_call json_mode path used dict(config) which fails on LLMConfig dataclass instances; fixed using dataclasses.is_dataclass + dataclasses.replace per D-10. 1 new test added for dataclass path. 110 tests pass.

structured_llm <- llm_client: LLMConfig.json_mode (bool, default False) matches what structured_call sets via dataclasses.replace; provider call() methods consume json_mode correctly; boundary exercised by tests/structured_llm/test_core.py json_mode tests (real dataclass path + dict path); no bridge logic; no import violations (structured_llm never imports toolkit.llm_client directly — client is injected).

Phase 5 closed: 110 tests pass (structured_llm + llm_client); integration check vs llm_client passes (LLMConfig.json_mode field compatible, injection boundary clean, no import violations); 2 gotchas promoted (dataclasses.replace for LLMConfig vs dict; Anthropic prefill asymmetry); all decisions D-1..D-11 were closed during execute/review; ARCHITECTURE.md row 8 updated to reflect json_mode phase completion.

Step 2: outermost-balanced-{...} fallback in parse_json_response + tests including fragmentation case. Step 3: unit test documenting OpenRouter reasoning separation (no code change). Step 4: docs sweep (ARCH Out of Scope update, Change History row). Dep probe on llm_client: no provider code change expected (reasoning field separation already exists); integration check deferred to CLOSE. No escalation triggers fired.
